settings.heading: No points to count. Just lower prices.
settings.text: We skip tiers and balances. Subscribe to what you already buy and the discount shows up in your cart, with more off as you add items.

settings.title: Subscribe to one item
settings.text: Choose refills, gel or a face cleanser and take 5% off every order, not only the first.

settings.title: Add a third item
settings.text: Three or more subscribed items takes 15% off each of them.

settings.title: Claim the extras
settings.text: Subscribers get free engraving on razor stands, a $15 value.

settings.title: One or two items
settings.perks: Every subscription order · skip or cancel any time

settings.title: Three or more items
settings.perks: On every subscribed item · access to the benefits shop

settings.title: Service discount
settings.perks: Veterans and active military · verified once a year

settings.label: Is there a points program?
settings.text: No. Savings come from subscribing and from bundle pricing, not from earning and spending points.

settings.label: Does the service discount stack with subscriptions?
settings.text: No. It applies once per year after verification and does not cover starter sets or the premium razor.

settings.label: What happens if I drop below three items?
settings.text: The 15% rate falls back to the standard 5% until you add another item.

settings.heading: New drops, first.
settings.message: Email for launches and offers. Prefer text? Add your number for the shipping updates and flash sales.
